verdict.rationale: llamafile starts its local HTTP server straight from the command line. The docs list a `--server` mode with HTTP server, API and Web UI options, and say to make the file executable and run it, after which the server answers at localhost:8080. A community user also praises the CLI and web-server UX. Missing for 10: any documented way to stop or shut down the server (no stop command or graceful-shutdown docs), and no lifecycle management such as background or daemon mode.
